name: New Hampshire Accents Fine Crafts, LLC

NHA now enters its 23rd year in business providing customers and contractors with furniture and woodworking that will last for generations to come and be cherished for a lifetime.
about:
New Hampshire Accents Fine Crafts, LLC was founded in 1997 by Alfred Spitzer, Jr. in Manchester, New Hampshire. The shop began with the goal of providing true custom furniture and woodworking that could rival off-the-shelf offerings.

The company operates as a custom woodworking shop, building one-of-a-kind furniture and cabinetry piece by piece. Its process covers design, construction using hand-selected kiln-dried lumber, and finishing with a range of products including water- and oil-based stains, shellac, polyurethane, and lacquer. Projects span custom furniture, entertainment units, fireplace surrounds, wall units, built-ins, coffered ceilings, wainscoting, trim, crown moulding, and furniture refinishing and repair.

The shop serves residential clients, interior designers, and contractors. Interior designer Andrea Srinivas has collaborated on custom millwork including live-edge tables and cabinets, while homeowner George Samuels brought in a 30-year-old Spanish olive-wood table for hinge repair and refinishing. The company also works with contractors on built-ins and architectural details.

Spitzer started the business to deliver furniture that would last for generations and be cherished for a lifetime. The company emphasizes environmentally friendly, sustainable choices and an expert team driven by knowledge and experience, with customer satisfaction as a top priority.
